articles.summary: January’s release: data review faster and more transparent with smarter search, clearer review signals, and better control over pre-labeled data. We’ve also expanded ML-assisted labeling with Amazon Bedrock support for greater flexibility.
articles.title: January 2026 Feature Updates: Smarter Reviews, Better Search, and Expanded Machine Learning Support

articles.summary: As we move past 2025, the Datasaur team has been hard at work delivering features that make data labeling more efficient, flexible, and intelligent. Whether you're annotating text for NLP models, managing complex labeling workflows, or building datasets for LLM training, this year's updates are designed to help you work smarter. Here's a rundown of what's new and why it matters.
articles.title: Datasaur's 2025 Feature Releases: Powering Smarter, Faster Data Labeling
